svg.title: Applications take t = 2, σ = 1/2, q′ = 1/2; at m = 0 the price is 2e−μη. The compulsory atom is charged at least once, independently of multiplicity. The distinct connected-set readiness estimate is the remaining rooted-tree input. The lift retains size and forced-atom counts separately; recovery preserves both tilt inequalities and hence this support-weighted tail on the same restored address family. The tilt reader has an exact multiplicity identity. Put Nf(D, r) = P i∈D forced ri and ehi = teμ1i forcedhi. Then Weh(D, r) = tN(D,r)eμNf(D,r)Wh(D, r).
